title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 01/2017
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > lead deck (?) > Sony TC-D5 > Maxell XLII 90's, recording by Craig L.

ai_review.summary: A fun spring‑82 Rochester gig with a smoking The Other One and solid drumming, captured on an otherwise clear soundboard despite a brief drop‑out at the end.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its spacy, high‑energy vibe, highlighted by a standout jam into The Other One and an early rendition of Satisfaction. Recording quality is generally good – volume is strong, audience bleed is just right, though one reviewer notes a drop‑out at the very end of the tape.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 4‑star ratings and highlighted strong musical performance with only minor recording issues, leading to an overall high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and loud soundboard mix with a pleasant amount of audience; a brief drop‑out occurs at the end of the recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Spacy and fun atmosphere with strong drumming jams leading into a smoking The Other One and a solid show‑ending.

band_member_comments.Drums: Space jam from the drums praised, feeding into an excellent The Other One.
